header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.arabic_text:
فَتَنْبُتُ مِنْهُ أَجْسَادُ النَّاسِ، ثُمَّ يُنْفَخُ فِيهِ أُخْرَي فَإِذَاهُمْ قِيَامٌ يَّنْظُرُونَ، ثُمَّ يُقَالُ: يأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ! هَلُمُّوا إِلي رَبِّكُمْ وَقِفُوهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ مَسْئُولُونَ، ثُمَّ يُقَالُ: أَخْرِجُوا بَعْثَ النَّارِ، فَيُقَالُ: مِنْ كَمْ؟ فَيُقَالُ: مِنْ كُلِّ اَلْفٍ تِسْعَمِائَةٍ وَتِسْعَةً وَّتِسْعِينَ، قَالَ: فَذَلِكَ يَوْمَ يَجْعَلُ الْوِلْدَانَ شِيباً وَذلِكَ يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَنْ سَاقٍ.
وَفِي رِوَايَةٍ:فَشَقَّ ذلِكَ عَلَي النَّاسِ حَتَّي تَغَيَّرَتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: مِنْ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ تِسْعَمِائَةٍ وَّتِسْعَةً وَّتِسْعِينَ وَمِنْكُمْ وَاحِدٌ.

blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) narrates what the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: “(Before the Day of Qiyamah comes) Dajjal will appear and he will remain in the world for forty. The narrator of this hadith says, I do not know whether by “forty’ the Prophet ﷺ meant forty days, forty months or forty years, and he further says”, “Then Allah will send Hazrat Isa ibn Maryam (AS) (into the world). The face of Hazrat Isa (AS) will resemble the face of Hazrat Urwah ibn Mas'ud (RA); his appearance and build will be like those of Hazrat Urwah ibn Mas'ud (RA). Hazrat Isa (AS) will search for Dajjal, and after seeking him out and catching him, he will kill him. After that, for seven years people will live in a state in which there is no enmity even between any two persons. Then Allah will send forth a (special) cool wind from Syria; when that wind touches them, not even those with an atom's weight of Iman will remain on the earth.
